column1: # NeurOne tDCS Research Database — Verification Ledger
# File: tdcs_verification_ledger.csv     Companion to: tdcs_database_full.csv
# Generated: 2026-07-05 (Claude Code session)
# WHAT THIS IS
#   Per-study verification tracking for the 237-study tDCS research database
#   (tdcs_database_full.csv). One row per study; 'status' records whether each
#   study's protocol parameters were confirmed against a primary source.
# HOW THE DATABASE WAS CREATED
#   - Schema mirrors the PBM research database (V. Heiskanen) supplied as the model;
#     columns L-S of that schema were replaced with tDCS protocol parameters:
#     type/polarity
#   - 237 studies were compiled across ~30 indications (1964-2024) from domain
#     knowledge plus targeted literature web searches. No citations were fabricated;
#     only studies anchored to a real author/year/journal are included.
#   - Current density was computed deterministically as current(mA)/area(cm2);
#     HD-tDCS ring montages and unconfirmed areas are left blank
# HOW VERIFICATION WAS DONE
#   - Primary full texts were retrieved by automated web fetch where openly
#     accessible (PMC
#     Methods were checked for electrode area
#     montage; discrepancies were corrected in the database and densities recomputed.
#   - Paywalled/blocked journals (NEJM
#     Neuropsychopharmacology
